## Essence words

momentum, nostalgia, cool, night, ambition, glamour

## Look

Deep violet sky, hot-pink and cyan neon, a striped setting sun on a magenta horizon grid, generic palm and skyline silhouettes, chrome type. Unlike TX-01's cold interior cyberspace, this is a warm, analog sunset.

## Motion grammar

The cruise: long eased scrolls (`sine.inOut`, 1 to 1.5 s), neon flicking on, passing-light streaks across the frame, slow-motion holds.

## Data skin

Pink-to-cyan gradient bars, outlined neon numerals.

## Video

Passing lights through a car window, mirror framing with no identifiable car, script title cards, synthwave at 85 to 118 BPM with gated-reverb drums.

## Boardroom translation

Avoid. If forced, keep only the palette, muted to dusk violet.

## Homage guardrails

No recreations of specific TV openings, film title scripts or costume pieces, and no real car models or brands. These sit on top of the [Homage Rule](../codex/homage-rule.md).

## Collision note

Clear. Best for community event promos, launches and retro gaming.
